Message:
the Successor from another world
used the staff bestowed unto him
by an angel to fight
a demon’s acolyte.

Which means angels and demons
are using humans to
fight their war for them.

Assuming that to be true,
it means neither
angels nor demons can enter
the physical world directly.

So instead, they grant
humans power, and at times,
possess their bodies to
meddle with the world.

That’s the hypothesis
I’ve reached based on
both the legend,
and the writings depicted
on that archeological site’s
murals and stone tablets...

But, there’s one question
I still can’t answer.

Just why would those
supposedly higher beings
depend so much
on us lowly humans...?

If they were also made by
the same creator we call God,
then it only follows that
they’re no different from us...

And, the reverse is true as well...
Humans can ascend into beings
rivaling both angels and demons...

It’s still nothing more
than a theory,
but I’ll prove it
in this experiment as well.

“So you’ve come, Meria...
I assume you’re
fully ready for this?”
